summary: Iteration 17 — verified the three new enhancements (Project.job_no field, default signature endpoint, /profile route with two new cards). 13/13 new backend pytest cases pass, full iter16 regression (27/27) still green, and frontend e2e confirms admin Settings shows both new cards, admin & engineer /profile both render correctly, engineer Navbar Profile link works, Project form persists Job No 3324, Project detail shows Job No badge, and SiteVisitFormPage auto-fills Job No '3324' from project.job_no (not project_code tail) when a project with job_no is picked. Default signature persists in /auth/me and is pre-loaded on new visits.

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning: <span> rendered as a child of <option>. Carried over from iter15/16 — cosmetic only.

action_items: (Cosmetic, carried over) Remove <span> children inside <option> in the SiteVisitFormPage template <select> to silence the React hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is still 4627 lines — should be split into routers (clients, projects, site_visits, audits, push, dashboard) in a future cleanup pass.

PUT /api/auth/me/signature enforces ~300KB by checking len(sig) > 400_000 (raw data-URL length). Comment says ~300KB but limit is on the data-URL string, not the decoded bytes — that is acceptable but document it.

Project.job_no has no uniqueness constraint or validation (any free-text). If users expect Job No to be unique per project this should be enforced; current behaviour allows duplicates which matches docstring intent of 'auto-fill helper' only.
On SiteVisitFormPage the default-signature pre-fill correctly skips when editing an existing visit (isEdit guard) and only sets when engineer_signature is empty — good.
